---
name: Bug report
about: Create a bug report to help us improve Alpamayo
title: "[BUG]"
labels: "? - Needs Triage, bug"
assignees: 'yesfandiari'

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Steps/Code to reproduce bug**
Follow this guide http://matthewrocklin.com/blog/work/2018/02/28/minimal-bug-reports to craft a minimal bug report. This helps us reproduce the issue and resolve it more quickly.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Environment overview (please complete the following information)**
 - Environment location: [Docker, Slurm, Cloud (specify cloud provider)]
 - Method of Deployment: [conda, Docker, or from source]
   - If method of install is [Docker], provide `docker pull` & `docker run` commands used
   - Object Store used (if applicable)

**Environment details**
 - Hardware: GPU type(s), GPUs used, distributed filesystems in use
 - Operating System
 - Number of physical nodes
 - Network connectivity between the nodes (if applicable)

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
